name: Calculator
title: React engineering calculator with document and canvas adapters
description: A React calculator for expressions and numerical calculus, with adapters that insert results into documents and canvases.

sections.heading: What does it do?
paragraphs: Use CalculatorApp for a standalone calculator, or embed Calculator, DocumentCalculator and CanvasCalculator in a React interface.

sections.heading: How do I install it?
paragraphs: Install the package and import its stylesheet once. React and React DOM 18 or newer are peer dependencies.

sections.heading: Does it require a backend?
paragraphs: The calculator runs in the browser. Your application controls storage and any document or canvas integration.

sections.heading: Which version does the playground show?
paragraphs: The playground imports this repository's source. It can include changes newer than the published npm package. Check npm dist-tags before choosing a stable or prerelease version.
